auto_pip_desc: Keep the video playing in a small window when you go to the home screen during playback.
auto_refresh_desc: Downloads fresh channel, film and series lists in the background when they get old.
clear_search_history_body: Your recent searches will be removed.
clear_watch_history_body: Continue watching, recently watched channels and saved positions will be removed for this account.
dl_err_dropped: The connection dropped and the server can’t resume it
dl_err_refused: Server refused (HTTP {0}). Your plan allows {1} connection(s), so it can’t download while something else is streaming.
dl_waiting_stream: Waiting until playback stops (your plan allows 1 connection)
downloads_empty_hint: Download films, episodes or whole seasons from their pages to watch them without internet.
edit_tip: Your favourites and watch history are kept.
err_connect: Couldn’t connect to the server. Check the address and port.
err_denied: The server refused access (HTTP {0}). Check your username and password, or your subscription.
err_not_xtream: This doesn’t look like an Xtream server
err_server: Enter the server address your provider gave you
err_ssl: Secure connection failed. Try the address with http:// instead of https://.
err_stream_format: This stream’s format isn’t supported on this device.
err_stream_network: Couldn’t reach the stream. Check your internet connection.
err_stream_refused: The server refused this stream. Your account may be expired or using all its connections.
err_timeout: The server took too long to respond. Try again.
err_unknown_host: Can’t find that server. Check the address and your internet connection.
expired: Your subscription expired on {0}. Renew it with your provider to keep watching.
hide_adult_desc: Hides categories and titles marked adult, XXX or 18+.
home_empty: Things you watch and favourite will show up here, so you can get back to them in one tap.
keyboard_hint: Space play/pause · ← → 10 seconds · ↑ ↓ volume · Page Up/Down channel · F full screen · M mute · Esc back
live_format_hint: If channels won’t play or keep buffering, try switching between TS and HLS.
login_subtitle: Sign in with the Xtream Codes details from your IPTV provider.
login_tip: Tip: you can also paste a full M3U link from your provider into the server field.
no_favourites_hint: Press and hold a channel or poster for options, or tap a channel’s star, to add it here.
no_favourites_hint_win: Right-click a channel or poster for options, or click a channel’s star, to add it here.
offline_body: Live TV and streaming need internet. Your downloads still play.
phone_desc: Scan the code with your phone’s camera and type your details there. Your phone must be on the same Wi-Fi as this TV.
phone_unavailable: This TV isn’t connected to a local network, so phone sign-in isn’t available. Use the form instead.
pip_unavailable: Picture-in-picture isn’t available until the video is showing.
player_hint: Automatic uses Apple’s player when it can and VLC for everything else. Apple’s player can’t play some films (like .mkv). Both support picture-in-picture.
qr_description: QR code to sign in from your phone
refresh_done: Channels, films and series are up to date
remove_account_body: Its login details, favourites and watch history will be deleted from this device.
split_connections: Your account allows {0} stream(s) at a time, so some windows may not play.
split_hint: OK: full screen · Hold OK: remove
split_pick_empty: Watch or favourite some channels first, then they’ll show up here.
storage_line: Downloads use {0} · {1} free on this device
try_different: Try a different search or category.
update_available_body: Version {0} is available (you have {1}). Your playlists, favourites, history and downloads are kept.
update_available_body_win: Version {0} is available (you have {1}). Shasha will close, update and open again. Your playlists, favourites, history and downloads are kept.
update_permission_body: Android needs your permission for Shasha to install updates. Tap Open settings, turn on “Allow from this source”, come back and tap Install.
web_done: Your TV is signed in. You can put your phone away.
web_expired: Scan the QR code on your TV again.
web_intro: Enter the Xtream Codes details from your IPTV provider. Your TV will sign in as soon as you tap the button.
